'''Francesc Gaset Fris''' (born 26 April 1947) is an [[Andorra]]n former [[sport shooter]] who competed at the [[1980 Summer Olympics|1980]] and [[1984 Summer Olympics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ga/francesco-gaset-1.html |title=Francesco Gaset |publisher=Sports Reference LLC |work=sports-reference.com |accessdate=September 28, 2014 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20131014022549/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ga/francesco-gaset-1.html |archivedate=October 14, 2013 }}</ref> He was the [[List of flag bearers for Andorra at the Olympics|flagbearer for Andorra]] at the 1980 Olympics.
